summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and 'the best singing in the city.'

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, August 2, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen, billed as retired champion pugilist of the world, ran his saloon at 619 Market Street with a free concert every evening
